title: Readiness Estimator: Waterborne Pathogen Sensors
definition: Estimates Waterborne Pathogen Sensors readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Waterborne Pathogen Sensors components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a sensor hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Waterborne Pathogen Sensors operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Waterborne Pathogen Sensors installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 24225 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where DNA sensors monitoring, sensor logistics redundancy, or treatment plants maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Waterborne Pathogen Sensors Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Waterborne Pathogen Sensors: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Waterborne Pathogen Sensors — sensors detecting water pathogens.

Phase 1 — Prove (DNA sensors): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (sensor logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (treatment plants): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (boil alerts): sensor hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and utilities-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
